purpose: Robustness check of TTL-free model vs 42-feature baseline; not an independent test
data: data/processed/train.csv only; official test set not read
ci_note: t-based 95% CIs are exploratory: repeated splits share data

criteria.C1: FPR on normals with sttl in {62, 254} decreases on >= 4 of 5 seeds AND the mean decrease exceeds the noise-control variation, defined as mean |slice FPR(baseline_alt) - slice FPR(baseline)| across seeds
criteria.C2: mean overall attack recall decreases by <= 0.5 percentage points
criteria.C3: mean Fuzzers recall and mean Analysis recall each decrease by <= 2 percentage points
criteria.C4: mean overall FPR increases by <= 0.5 percentage points
